headline: Records Show $270 Million in AI Equipment Linked to Alice Huang in China
summary: Companies linked to Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang obtained $270m in financing backed by high-performance computing equipment for AI data centres in China. Her relationship with Jensen Huang preceded his brief exit from Nvidia.
why: Nvidia designs the AI chips used in data centres, and export controls and China-related demand are major factors in its revenue outlook.
original_headline: Registros muestran 270 millones de dólares en equipos de IA asociados a Alice Huang en China
